assertions.assertion: The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations.
The patient has known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The monitoring is intended to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias.
The monitoring is intended to assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The procedure at issue is CPT 93229.
The denial was based on Reason Code CO-197.
